name: Ozinexus Missed Enquiry Detector
author: Simmi Ahuja

sections.description:
Are you losing enquiries without realizing it?

Ozinexus Missed Enquiry Detector helps business owners, freelancers, and agencies identify common usability patterns that may prevent visitors from successfully contacting a website.

Instead of guessing why enquiries are not coming in, this plugin provides a clear, educational diagnostic report directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

It does not track users, submit forms, or send data externally. All checks are passive and read-only.

🔍 What This Plugin Checks

  • Whether a Contact page can be detected
  • Whether a visible enquiry form is present
  • Whether a confirmation or thank-you step exists
  • Whether basic email delivery configuration can be identified
  • Whether common enquiry blockers may exist

The results are presented as a visitor journey, helping you understand what a real user may experience on your site.

📊 Educational Enquiry Risk & Estimates

The plugin may display an estimated range of potential enquiries at risk.

Important:
These figures are educational estimates only, based on industry-standard usability models and average small-business traffic scenarios.
They are not records of actual lost enquiries, guarantees, or analytics data.

This approach helps non-technical users understand risk, not panic.

🧠 Built for Business Clarity (Not Fear)

  • Uses careful language such as “may”, “potential”, “estimated”
  • No forced upgrades
  • No misleading alerts
  • No auto-fixing or intrusive actions

You stay in full control.

🧩 Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Business owners who want peace of mind that enquiries are not being missed
  • Agencies & freelancers who want a diagnostic tool to explain conversion issues to clients
  • Consultants who want a clear pre-flight check before optimization work

🔒 Pro Version (Optional)

The free version focuses on diagnostics only.

The optional Pro version (separate plugin) adds features such as:
– Scan history & comparisons
– Enquiry delivery verification
– Scheduled monitoring & alerts
– Client-ready reports

The free plugin works fully on its own.

🚀 Privacy & Performance

  • No tracking
  • No cookies
  • No external API calls
  • No background cron jobs
  • Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Ozinexus → Missed Enquiry Detector in your admin menu.
  4. Click Run Enquiry Scan.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin submit test enquiries or send emails?

No. All checks are passive and read-only.

Does this plugin guarantee more leads?

No. It identifies potential risk areas so you can make informed improvements.

What if my Contact page has a custom name?

You can manually select or provide your Contact page URL inside the plugin to improve scan accuracy.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. It does not collect or transmit personal data.
